async function s(e) {
	try {
		let t = (await fetch(e, { method: `HEAD` })).headers.get(`content-length`), n = t === null ? 0 : parseInt(t, 10);
		return Number.isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
	} catch (e) {
		return console.error(`Error fetching file size:`, e), 0;
	}
}

function u(e) {
	let t = new e$1(e);
	return t.compare(`2023.3.0b7`) >= 0 ? {
		url: `https://download.unity3d.com/download_unity/open-jdk/open-jdk-mac-x64/jdk17.0.9-9_388f7edd2524a9235650fa7cf531302e4676b80526b2d6a0fa199d030779169d.zip`,
		version: `17.0.9+9`,
		main: !0,
		installedSize: 221,
		downloadSize: 118.2
	} : t.compare(`2022.2.0a1`) >= 0 ? {
		url: `https://download.unity3d.com/download_unity/open-jdk/open-jdk-mac-x64/jdk11.0.14.1-1_236fc2e31a8b6da32fbcf8624815f509c51605580cb2c6285e55510362f272f8.zip`,
		version: `11.0.14.1+1`,
		main: !0,
		installedSize: 230.2,
		downloadSize: 118.5
	} : {
		url: `http://download.unity3d.com/download_unity/open-jdk/open-jdk-mac-x64/jdk8u172-b11_4be8440cc514099cfe1b50cbc74128f6955cd90fd5afe15ea7be60f832de67b4.zip`,
		version: `8u172-b11`,
		main: !0,
		installedSize: 165,
		downloadSize: 72.7
	};
}
function d(e) {
	switch (e) {
		case `monodevelop`:
		case `documentation`:
		case `exampleprojects`:
		case `example`:
		case `visualstudio`: return !0;
		default: return !1;
	}
}
function f(e, t, n) {
	let i = !1;
	if (t != null) {
		let e = new e$1(`6000.5.0a2`), n = new e$1(t);
		n != null && n.compare(e) >= 0 && (i = !0);
	}
	switch (e) {
		case `mono`:
		case `visualstudio`: return null;
		case `monodevelop`:
		case `documentation`: return `{UNITY_PATH}`;
		case `standardassets`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/Standard Assets`;
		case `exampleprojects`:
		case `example`: return `/Users/Shared/Unity`;
		case `android`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AndroidPlayer`;
		case `android-sdk-build-tools`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AndroidPlayer/SDK/build-tools`;
		case `android-sdk-platforms`:
		case `android-sdk-platforms-29`:
		case `android-sdk-platforms-30`:
		case `android-sdk-platforms-31`:
		case `android-sdk-platforms-32`:
		case `android-sdk-platforms-33`:
		case `android-sdk-platforms-34`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AndroidPlayer/SDK/platforms`;
		case `android-sdk-platform-tools`:
		case `android-sdk-ndk-tools`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AndroidPlayer/SDK`;
		case `android-ndk`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AndroidPlayer/NDK`;
		case `android-sdk-command-line-tools`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AndroidPlayer/SDK/cmdline-tools`;
		case `android-open-jdk`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AndroidPlayer/OpenJDK`;
		case `cmake`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AndroidPlayer/SDK/cmake/cmake`;
		case `ios`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines`;
		case `tvos`:
		case `appletv`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/AppleTVSupport`;
		case `linux`:
		case `linux-mono`:
		case `linux-il2cpp`:
		case `linux-server`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/LinuxStandaloneSupport`;
		case `mac`:
		case `mac-mono`:
		case `mac-il2cpp`:
		case `mac-server`: return i ? `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/MacStandaloneSupport` : `{UNITY_PATH}/Unity.app/Contents/PlaybackEngines/MacStandaloneSupport`;
		case `samsungtv`:
		case `samsung-tv`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/STVPlayer`;
		case `tizen`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/TizenPlayer`;
		case `vuforia`:
		case `vuforia-ar`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/VuforiaSupport`;
		case `webgl`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/WebGLSupport`;
		case `windows`:
		case `windows-mono`:
		case `windows-il2cpp`:
		case `windows-server`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/WindowsStandaloneSupport`;
		case `facebook`:
		case `facebook-games`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/Facebook`;
		case `facebookgameroom`: return null;
		case `lumin`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/LuminSupport`;
		case `visionos`: return `{UNITY_PATH}/PlaybackEngines/VisionOSPlayer`;
		default:
	}
	return e.startsWith(`language-`) ? i ? `{UNITY_PATH}/Localization` : `{UNITY_PATH}/Unity.app/Contents/Localization` : `{UNITY_PATH}`;
}

		this.config.outputFile.endsWith(`.json`) || (this.config.outputFile = `${this.config.outputFile}.json`);
		for (let t of Object.keys(e)) {
			let n = this.config.outputFile.replace(`.json`, `-${t}.json`);
			if (Object.keys(e[t]).length <= 0) throw Error(`No releases found for platform ${t}. Not creating the file ${n}`);
			Object.keys(e[t]).forEach((n) => {
				e[t][n] = re(e[t][n], `version`);
			});
			try {
				await fs.promises.writeFile(n, JSON.stringify(e[t], null, 2));
			} catch (e) {
				throw Error(`Error while writing to file ${n} ${e}`);
			}
		}
	}
	static async validateReleasesInfo(e, t) {
		if (!e || Object.entries(e).length === 0) throw Error(`No releases found. Not validating`);
		let n = [], r = {
			isValidStatus: `success`,
			details: {}
		};
		for (let i of Object.keys(e)) {
			r.details[i] = {};
			for (let a of Object.keys(e[i])) {
				r.details[i][a] = {};
				for (let o of e[i][a]) {
					let e = oe(r, o, i, a, t);
					n.push(e);
				}
			}
		}
		return Promise.all(n).then(() => r).catch((e) => Promise.reject(Error(`Error while validating the platforms ${e} ${e.stack}`)));
	}
	async getReleaseInfoPerPlatform(e, t, n, r) {
		let i = this._getIniUrl(e, t, n), a = await this._fetchIniFile(i);
		if (!a || a.length <= 0) throw Error(`empty ini file`);
		return this._buildRelease(e, this.config).getReleaseInfoFromIni(Q.default.parse(a), t, n, r);
	}
	_buildRelease(e, t) {
		return new X(e, t);
	}
	_getIniUrl(e, t, n) {
		return `${[
			`${e.downloadBaseUrl}unity`,
			e.version,
			ie[t].iniName,
			n?.toLowerCase().startsWith(o.X86_64) ? null : n?.toLowerCase()
		].filter((e) => e).join(`-`)}.ini`;
	}
	async _fetchIniFile(e) {
		return Y(e) ? await (await fetch(e)).text() : (await fs.promises.readFile(e)).toString();
	}
};
async function oe(e, t, n, r, i = Z) {
	let a = await i(t);
	e.details[n][r][t.version] = a, a.validCount === 0 ? e.isValidStatus = `error` : a.validCount < a.totalCount && e.isValidStatus === `success` && (e.isValidStatus = `partial`);
}
//#endregion
